description: This Python source file provides utility functions to extract and process metadata from a build/testing environment, especially related to BitBake build system information, OS details, Git repository state, and layers. It seems to be part of a testing or build metadata collection framework within a Yocto Project or OpenEmbedded context.

methods.name: metadata_from_bb()
methods.description: Retrieves build environment metadata using BitBake variables and system information, returning it as an ordered dictionary.

methods.name: metadata_from_data_store(d)
methods.description: Placeholder function intended to retrieve metadata from a provided data store; currently not implemented.

methods.name: git_rev_info(path)
methods.description: Gathers Git revision details such as branch, commit hash, and commit count for the given repository path.

methods.name: get_layers(layers)
methods.description: Processes a list of layer paths and retrieves their Git revision information, returning a dictionary.

methods.name: write_metadata_file(file_path, metadata)
methods.description: Serializes a metadata dictionary into XML format and writes it to a specified file.

methods.name: dict_to_XML(tag, dictionary, **kwargs)
methods.description: Recursively converts a dictionary into an XML Element suitable for serialization.
